name: Making Time For God
overview: Scripture calls believers to intentionally prioritize their relationship with God, recognizing that there is a divinely appointed time to seek Him (Ecclesiastes 3:1; Hosea 10:12). The soul's deep longing for God is likened to a hart panting for water, illustrating the necessity of spiritual thirst and dependence (Psalms 42:1). Believers are encouraged to be still and focus on God's sovereignty (Psalms 46:10), waiting patiently and trusting in Him alone for their hope (Psalms 62:5). Above all, seeking God's kingdom and righteousness is to be the foremost pursuit, promising that all other needs will be met as a result (Matthew 6:33).
